pair_replacement_policy: FORBIDDEN; failures and blocked methods remain attached to the frozen pair

dense_input_contract.scope: Full autosomal post-QC dense summary statistics for both traits in every pair
dense_input_contract.alignment_rule: Inner join by exact rsID plus hg19 chromosome and position; require an exact unordered non-palindromic allele pair, flip trait2 Z/BETA only for an unambiguous allele swap, and never use proxies or position-only matches

pair_materialization_plausibility.failure_rule: If any absolute, fractional, or autosome-coverage floor fails, pair materialization is FAILED_QC and no PLACO task or scientific result may be published

placo_plus.primary_pair_family_correction: 5e-8 / 2 frozen primary pairs A and B; CONTROL is excluded
placo_plus.within_pair_bh_family: For each pair separately, every aligned eligible genome-wide variant is one hypothesis; retain the full PLACO P ledger, assign P=1 to individual numerical failures, and compute BH across that complete fixed family
placo_plus.bh_role: Method-specific secondary evidence; BH significance never upgrades an A/B locus to the 2.5e-8 primary headline
placo_plus.control_role: Positive-control recovery only; CONTROL is never included in the A/B correction family and never supports novelty

conjfdr.independence_rule: A validated conjFDR<=0.05 locus enters the method union even when PLACO is nonsignificant, unavailable, or blocked; PLACO intersection is not required

ld_reference_policy.purpose: PLACO lead clumping, method-specific locus definition, and cross-method LD-locus reconciliation
ld_reference_policy.raw_reference_fidelity_rule: Seal the untouched chr1-23 source family with 22,665,064 variants; chr23 is retained only because it is checksum-bound inside the pinned archive and must not be relabeled as autosomal; do not derive or relabel an autosome-only BED/BIM/FAM unless a later method contract explicitly requires it
ld_reference_policy.analysis_chromosome_rule: Only GRCh37 chr1-22 (22,132,657 variants) are eligible for PLACO clumping, method reconciliation, materialization plausibility counts, downstream loci, or claims; chr23/X is always forbidden from Track B analysis
ld_reference_policy.materialization_transform_rule: Byte-identical extraction of the pinned BED/BIM/FAM members only; no LD-block splitting, clumping, SNP reduction, filtering, recoding, or scientific selection occurs during reference materialization
ld_reference_policy.clump_index_threshold_rule: Use the applicable method-specific inclusion threshold; never use the A/B 2.5e-8 headline threshold for CONTROL
ld_reference_policy.reference_variant_rule: Exact rsID, coordinate, and unordered allele match to the full EUR BIM; no proxies and no remote clumping
ld_reference_policy.reference_absence_rule: A significant variant absent from the sealed full reference is retained in the method ledger but is BLOCKED_BY_LD_REFERENCE_COVERAGE for canonical locus assignment
ld_reference_policy.lead_independence_rule: Within each pair and method, lead variants must have pairwise r2<0.1 within 1 Mb in the sealed full EUR reference
ld_reference_policy.cross_method_locus_rule: PLACO and conjFDR signals support the same signal only when significant variants are linked at r2>=0.6 in the sealed EUR reference; distance-only, r2>=0.1 alone, or broad LAVA-block overlap is insufficient

evidence_union.primary_pair_inclusion_rule: For A/B, retain the union of PLACO P<=5e-8, complete-family within-pair PLACO BH q<=0.05, and conjFDR<=0.05 loci; tag the stricter PLACO P<=2.5e-8 subset as primary headline
evidence_union.control_inclusion_rule: Audit CONTROL separately at PLACO P<=5e-8, within-control PLACO BH q<=0.05, and conjFDR<=0.05; never merge CONTROL into the A/B discovery family
evidence_union.comparison_only_label_rule: PLACO_ONLY or CONJFDR_ONLY may be emitted only when both methods completed and passed QC for that pair; if the other method is blocked, unavailable, or failed QC, preserve method availability and do not emit an ONLY label
evidence_union.label_rule: Emit every applicable label in the frozen order; a cross-method label supplements rather than replaces its method-specific labels

method_state_semantics.blocked_rule: A blocked or unavailable method is NOT_TESTED_METHOD_BLOCKED, not P=1, q=1, TESTED_NO_HIT, absence of pleiotropy, or evidence against the other method
method_state_semantics.zero_hit_rule: TESTED_NO_HIT is legal only after a complete checksum-sealed genome-wide scan, complete family accounting, and all method QC gates pass
method_state_semantics.partial_completion_rule: Never publish an empty scientific result table for a blocked method; publish only the readiness gate and preserve the blocker
method_state_semantics.union_when_one_method_blocked: A completed method may publish method-specific evidence and claim limits while the other method remains explicitly NOT_TESTED_METHOD_BLOCKED

execution_order.placo_and_conjfdr_ordering: INDEPENDENT; neither completed method is an execution prerequisite for the other

claim_limits.primary: A validated Track B locus is statistical cross-trait pleiotropic evidence only; it does not establish a shared causal variant, biological mechanism, mediation, or causal direction
claim_limits.placo: PLACO association and within-pair BH support are method-specific statistical evidence; only P<=2.5e-8 in A/B is eligible for the frozen PLACO primary-family headline
claim_limits.conjfdr: conjFDR<=0.05 is independent method-specific discovery evidence and does not validate PLACO, fine-map a causal variant, or establish mechanism
claim_limits.cross_method: PLACO and conjFDR evidence in the same EUR LD locus is cross-method statistical convergence, not proof that both methods identify the same causal signal
claim_limits.control: CONTROL can evaluate expected pipeline recovery and concordance only; it is excluded from novelty, primary-family significance, and mechanistic claims
claim_limits.blocked: A blocked method yields no scientific result and cannot be described as null, negative, nonsignificant, or discordant
